verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships a native openclaw CLI with subcommands documented across the docs (e.g., openclaw mcp serve, openclaw security audit, openclaw skills search/install/update), and a dedicated CLI reference page confirms this (official CLI documented at docs.openclaw.ai/cli). This aligns well with agentic, AI-native workflows (skills, MCP, security audits) driven entirely from the terminal. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of CLI usage beyond first-party docs, and a full command reference enumeration.
